Rashi on Bava Metzia 12b:10:1.hebrew: מקל וחומר - בפרק קמא דקדושין (דף טז.): מה סימנין, שאין מוציאין מרשות האב, מוציאין מרשות האדון — כדילפינן: "ויצאה חנם", אלו ימי בגרות; "אין כסף", אלו ימי נערות — מיתת האב, שמוציאה מרשות האב, שאינו מוריש לבניו מה שזכתה לו תורה בבתו, שיהא מעשה ידיה לאחין, כדילפינן (כתובות דף מג.): "והתנחלתם אותם לבניכם", ולא בנותיכם לבניכם — אינו דין שמוציאה מרשות האדון:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 12b:10:1.english: From an a fortiori inference - In the first chapter of Kiddushin (16a): Just as signs [of puberty], which do not remove [her] from the authority of the father, remove [her] from the authority of the master — as we derive: "And she shall go out for nothing" — these are the days of bagrut [adulthood]; "without money" — these are the days of na'arut [maidenhood] — [so too] the death of the father, which removes her from the authority of the father, for he does not bequeath to his sons that which the Torah granted him with respect to his daughter, [namely,] that her handiwork should belong to the brothers, as we derive (Ketubot 43a): "And you shall bequeath them to your sons," [them] and not your daughters to your sons — is it not logical that it removes her from the authority of the master?

Rashi on Bava Metzia 12b:10:2.english: But wasn't Rabbi Shimon ben Lakish conclusively refuted - In Kiddushin (ibid.).

Rashi on Bava Metzia 12b:12:1.hebrew: לאפוקי דרבה - לאפוקי שאינו של רבה אלא של אביה, וקרי ליה שלהן משום דאב מינה קזכי:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 12b:12:1.english: To exclude her master's - To exclude [him, meaning] that it is not her master's, but rather her father's; and [the Mishnah] calls it "theirs" because the father acquires [it] through her.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 12b:14:1.hebrew: במגורשת ואינה מגורשת - כגון זרק לה גיטה, ספק קרוב לה ספק קרוב לו, ברה"ר:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 12b:14:1.english: With [a woman who is] divorced and not divorced - For example, [where her husband] threw her bill of divorce to her, [and it is] uncertain [whether it landed] closer to her [or] closer to him, in the public domain.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 12b:14:2.hebrew: חייב במזונותיה - ומשום הכי אצטריך לאשמועינן דמציאתה שלה, דטעמא מאי אמור רבנן מציאת האשה כו':
Rashi on Bava Metzia 12b:14:2.english: [Her husband] is obligated for her sustenance - And for this reason it was necessary to teach us that her find is hers, for what is the reason the Sages said [that] a wife's find [belongs to her husband], etc.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 12b:16:1.english: A property guarantee - A lien on lands from which [the creditor] may collect.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 12b:16:2.hebrew: יחזיר ולא יחזיר - טעמא בגמ' מפרש:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 12b:16:2.english: He returns [them] and he may not return [them] - The reason is explained in the Gemara.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 12b:18:1.english: When [the] liable party admits - That the borrower admits that the note is not paid.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 12b:18:2.hebrew: אמאי לא יחזיר - אם לטרוף לקוחות בא, בדין הוא טורפן:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 12b:18:2.english: Why should he not return [them] - If he comes to seize [property from] buyers, by law he seizes [from] them.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 12b:18:3.english: From liened [property] - From real estate that he sold afterward.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 12b:1:1.hebrew: עשו את שאינו זוכה כזוכה - אע"פ שאין לקטן זכייה במקום אחר, כאן עשאוהו כזוכה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 12b:1:1.english: They rendered one who does not acquire like one who acquires - Even though a minor has no [right of] acquisition elsewhere, here they rendered him like one who acquires.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 12b:1:2.hebrew: מאי טעמא עניים גופייהו ניחא להו - בהאי תקנתא, דכי אגרו להו לדידהו כו':
Rashi on Bava Metzia 12b:1:2.english: What is the reason? The poor people themselves are satisfied - with this ordinance, for when they themselves are hired, etc.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 12b:21:1.hebrew: הני ריעי - הואיל ונפל, אתרע, דיש לומר: אם היה כשר, היה נזהר בו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 12b:21:1.english: These [notes] are compromised - Since it fell, it has become compromised, for one can say: If it were valid, he would have been careful with it.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 12b:2:1.hebrew: ופליגא - דשמואל, דפירש טעמא דמתניתין משום דלית ליה זכייה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 12b:2:1.english: And [it] disagrees - [that] of Shmuel, who explained the reason of the Mishnah [is] because [a minor] has no [capacity for] acquisition.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 12b:2:2.hebrew: אדר' חייא בר אבא - דאמר אף גדול שיש לו זכייה, אם סמוך הוא על שולחן אביו, מציאתו לאביו משום איבה; אבל אינו סמוך על שולחן אביו, אפילו הוא קטן, מציאתו שלו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 12b:2:2.english: [Disagrees] with Rabbi Chiyya bar Abba - Who says [that] even an adult, who has [the legal capacity of] acquisition, if he is dependent on his father's table, his found item [belongs] to his father because of enmity; but [if] he is not dependent on his father's table, even [if] he is a minor, his found item is his.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 12b:3:1.hebrew: לא יהא אלא פועל - לא יהא עבדו אלא שכיר בעלמא. תנינא דמציאתו לבעל הבית בזמן שלא פירש לו לאיזו מלאכה שכרו, ועבד זה כשקנאו רבו, לסתם מלאכה קנאו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 12b:3:1.english: Let him be merely a laborer - Let his slave be merely an ordinary hired worker. We have learned that his found item belongs to the employer when he did not specify to him for which work he hired him; and this slave, when his master acquired him, he acquired him for unspecified work.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 12b:5:1.hebrew: שאין רבו רוצה לשנותו - הלכך לא ניחא ליה שיגביה לו מציאה, דמציאה מעולה בדמיה משכר ביטול מלאכתו לא שכיחא. הלכך, אי אתרמי ואשכח, שלו הוא, וישלם לרבו שכר ביטולו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 12b:5:1.english: That his master does not want to change him [to another task] - Therefore, it is not pleasing to [his master] that [the slave] should pick up a lost item for him, since a lost item whose value exceeds the compensation for the interruption of his work is uncommon. Therefore, if it happens that he finds [one], it is his, and he pays his master compensation for his lost work time.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 12b:6:1.hebrew: עם מלאכתו - שלא ביטל כלום, הלכך לעצמו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 12b:6:1.english: With his work - For he did not interrupt [his work] at all; therefore, [it belongs] to himself.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 12b:7:1.english: Rav Pappa said - [This refers to] that which was taught [in a baraita]: "A laborer's find belongs to the employer."

Rashi on Bava Metzia 12b:7:2.english: That he hired him to collect found items - Many [of them].

Rashi on Bava Metzia 12b:7:3.english: And what are the circumstances - [in which] it happens [that one hires him to collect found items].

Rashi on Bava Metzia 12b:7:4.hebrew: דאקפי אגמא בכוורי - שצף הנהר חוץ לגדותיו וצפו הדגים שם, וכשיבשו המים היוצאים נמצאו שם דגים הרבה. "דאקפי" תרגום של "הציף", כדמתרגמינן "ויצף הברזל" — "וקפא ברזלא" (מלכים ב ו׳:ו׳):
Rashi on Bava Metzia 12b:7:4.english: Where a lake flooded with fish - [This means] that the river overflowed beyond its banks and the fish floated there, and when the waters that had gone out dried up, many fish were found there. "De'akpei" is the Aramaic translation of "hetzif" [caused to float], as we translate "vayatzef habarzel" ("and the iron floated") [as] "vekafa barzela" (II Kings 6:6).

Rashi on Bava Metzia 12b:8:1.english: Why is she with him - Behold, it was taught [in a baraita that] she goes free with signs [of puberty].

Rashi on Bava Metzia 12b:9:1.hebrew: דאבוה הויא - מציאתה, דהא קטנה היא:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 12b:9:1.english: [It] is her father's - Her found item, since she is a minor.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 12b:9:2.hebrew: ואי דליתיה לאב - מאי בעיא גבי האדון? תיפוק מיניה במיתת האב:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 12b:9:2.english: And if her father is not [alive] - What is she doing with the master? She should have gone free from him with the death of [her] father.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 12b:19:1.hebrew: ולא לוה עד תשרי - פירוש: ועתה רוצה ללות בו, שיש לו טורח לכתוב שטר אחר, וגם כדי להרויח פשיטי דספרא. אבל אין לפרש שכבר לוה בו קודם שנפל, דא"כ מאי משני "הני ריעי" — לפי שנפל, ויש הוכחה דמשום פסולו לא נזהר לשומרו? והא לוה בו כבר, ופשיטא שנזהר לשומרו:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 12b:19:1.english: And he did not borrow until Tishrei - Explanation: And now [in Tishrei] he wants to borrow with it, because it is a bother for him to write another document, and also in order to save the scribe's fee. However, one should not explain that he already borrowed with it before it fell, for if so, what does [the Gemara] answer, "These are impaired" — [meaning that] because it fell, there is proof that due to its invalidity he was not careful to guard it? For he already borrowed with it, and it is obvious that he was careful to guard it!

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 12b:22:1.hebrew: כותבין שטר ללוה אף על פי שאין מלוה עמו - וליכא למיחש למחזי לשקרא כמו באשרתא דדייני, דאם כתבו קודם דנחזי חתימת ידי סהדי, פסולה; דהכא, כיון שהוא כותב חובתו, לא שייך מחזי כשקרא:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 12b:22:1.english: One may write a [promissory] note for a borrower even if the lender is not with him - And there is no need to be concerned about [it] appearing as a falsehood, as [there is] in [the case of] a judicial certification [of a document], where if [the judges] wrote it before they examined the signatures of the witnesses, it is invalid; for here, since [the borrower] is writing [a note of] his own obligation, [the concern of] appearing as a falsehood does not apply.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 12b:2:1.hebrew: רבי יוחנן אמר לא גדול גדול ממש - מפרש ר"ת: כי היכי דפליגי הכא, פליגי נמי גבי עירוב, דתנן בפ' חלון (עירובין דף עט: ושם ד"ה ומזכה): ומזכה להם על ידי בנו ובתו. ולשמואל דאמר הכא קטן ממש, התם נמי גבי עירוב אינו זוכה, דידו כיד אביו; כיון דמציאתו לאביו, ה"ה כל זכיותיו לאביו. ואמה העבריה, אע"פ שהיא קטנה, זכיא בעירובה, דמציאתה אינה לאדוניה. אף על גב דשמואל אית ליה פרק התקבל (גיטין דף סד: ושם ד"ה אלא) קטן זוכה לעצמו ואינו זוכה לאחרים — הא משני התם: שאני שתופי מבואות דרבנן. והא דאמר שמואל פרק מי שהוציאוהו (עירובין דף מט. ושם: ד"ה וקטן) דעירוב משום קנין, ורבא אמר משום דירה, ואמר איכא בינייהו קטן — הא פר"ח התם דאית ליה בית לקטן קאמר, ולא כפרש"י שפי' שאינו גובה העירוב לפי שאינו זוכה. ולר"י דאמר לא גדול גדול ממש, ה"ה דגבי עירוב נמי, דקטן ואינו סמוך על שולחן אביו זוכה כאמה העבריה, וגדול סמוך על שולחן אביו אינו זוכה. וצריך ליזהר שלא לזכות העירוב ע"י בנו הגדול הסמוך לשולחנו, דקי"ל כרבי יוחנן לגבי שמואל, כדאמר פרק מי שהוציאוהו (עירובין מז:). ועבדו ושפחתו העברים, אע"ג דסמוכין על שולחנו, מציאתם לעצמם, וכן זוכין בעירוב ולא הוי ידם כיד האדון; דלא שייך איבה אלא בבנו, שדרכו לזונו תמיד ואם לא יפרנסו אביו לא יפרנסנו אחר, אבל אדם אחר מעלמא סמוך על שולחן חבירו חנם, כגון יתום וכיוצא בו, אין סברא שתהא מציאתו לחבירו, וכ"ש עבד ואמה שבשכר טרחם הם אוכלים. ובתו, אפילו נערה ואינה סמוכה על שולחן אביה, מציאתה לאביה משום איבה, דאי בעי מסר לה למנוול ומוכה שחין, כדאמר בפרק נערה (כתובות דף מו ושם). ודלא כרש"י שפירש משום דכתיב בנעוריה, דההוא בהפרת נדרים הוא דכתיב, כדאיתא בפרק קמא דקדושין (דף ג: ושם) ופרק נערה (כתובות מו:). ואשתו דזכיא בעירוב, אף על גב דידה כיד בעלה, מוקי לה בסוף נדרים (דף פח:) דאית לה בית באותו מבוי, דמגו דזכיא לנפשה זכיא נמי לאחריני:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 12b:2:1.english: Rabbi Yochanan says: "Adult" [does] not [mean] an actual adult - Rabbeinu Tam explains: Just as they disagree here [regarding a lost item], they also disagree regarding an eiruv, as we learned in the Mishnah in the chapter [entitled] Chalon (Eruvin 79b, and there s.v. Umezakeh): "And one may confer possession [of the eiruv] on their behalf through his son or daughter." And according to Shmuel, who says here [that the Mishnah refers to] an actual minor, there too regarding an eiruv he cannot acquire [on behalf of others], since his hand is like the hand of his father; since his found item belongs to his father, the same applies to all his acquisitions, [which belong] to his father. And a Hebrew maidservant, even though she is a minor, can acquire her eiruv [on behalf of others], because her found item does not belong to her master. Even though Shmuel holds in the chapter [entitled] HaTzkabel (Gittin 64b, and there s.v. Ella) [that] a minor can acquire for himself but cannot acquire for others — [the Gemara] answers there: Mergers of alleyways (shitufei mevo'ot) are different, as they are rabbinic. And that which Shmuel says in the chapter [entitled] Mi SheHotzi'uhu (Eruvin 49a, and there 49b s.v. VeKatan) that an eiruv is [effective] because of acquisition (kinyan), while Rava says [it is] because of dwelling (dirah), and [the Gemara] says [that] the practical difference between them is a minor — Rabbeinu Chananel explained there that it is speaking of a minor who owns a house, and not like Rashi, who explained that he cannot collect the eiruv because he cannot acquire. And according to Rabbi Yochanan, who says "adult" [does] not [mean] an actual adult, the same applies regarding an eiruv as well: a minor who is not supported at his father's table can acquire [it] like a Hebrew maidservant, whereas an adult who is supported at his father's table cannot acquire [it]. And one must be careful not to confer possession of the eiruv through his adult son who is supported at his table, because we rule in accordance with Rabbi Yochanan against Shmuel, as [the Gemara] states in the chapter [entitled] Mi SheHotzi'uhu (Eruvin 47b). And one's Hebrew manservant and maidservant, even though they are supported at his table, their found items belong to themselves, and likewise they can acquire [on behalf of others] with an eiruv and their hand is not like the hand of the master; for animosity (eivah) is only relevant with his son, whom it is his custom to feed regularly and if his father does not support him no one else will support him, whereas any other person from the general public who is supported at his fellow's table for free, such as an orphan and the like, there is no basis [to say] that his found item should belong to his fellow — and all the more so a servant and maidservant, who eat in return for the labor of their exertion. And his daughter, even [when she is] a young woman (na'arah) and is not supported at her father's table, her found item belongs to her father because of animosity, for if he wanted he could hand her over [in marriage] to a repulsive person or one afflicted with boils, as [the Gemara] states in the chapter [entitled] Na'arah (Ketubot 46 and there). And this is unlike Rashi, who explained [that it belongs to her father] because it is written "in her youth," for that is written regarding the annulment of vows, as is stated in the first chapter of Kiddushin (3b and there) and the chapter [entitled] Na'arah (Ketubot 46b). And [regarding] his wife, who can acquire [on behalf of others] with an eiruv even though her hand is like her husband's hand — [the Gemara] establishes it at the end of Nedarim (88b) [as referring to a case] where she owns a house in that alleyway, for since she can acquire for herself, she can also acquire for others.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 12b:6:1.hebrew: במגביה מציאה עם מלאכתו - וא"ת: הא דתניא בפ"ק דקדושין (דף טז:), "אמה העבריה מציאתה לאביה ושכר בטלה לרבה", היכי מתוקמא אליבא דרבא? דאם הגביהה עם מלאכתו — ליכא שכר בטלה, ואם לא הגביהה עם מלאכתו — א"כ מציאתה לאדוניה. וי"ל: דהתם ודאי צריך להעמיד בנוקבת מרגליות:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 12b:6:1.english: [We are dealing] with [one who] lifts a found item along with [performing] his work - And if you ask: That which is taught in a baraita in the first chapter of Kiddushin (16b), "A Hebrew maidservant — her found item belongs to her father, and compensation for [her] idleness [goes] to her master" — how is it established according to Rava? For if she lifted it along with [performing] her work, there is no compensation for idleness, and if she did not lift it along with [performing] her work, then her found item belongs to her master. And one can answer: There, it must certainly be established as [a case of] one who pierces pearls.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 12b:7:1.hebrew: ששכרו ללקט מציאות - וה"פ דברייתא: בד"א בזמן שאמר ליה עשה עמי באותו ענין שהוא כמו "נכש עמי היום", אבל אמר ליה "עשה עמי מלאכה" של מציאות כו':
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 12b:7:1.english: Where he hired him to collect found items - And this is the explanation of the baraita: In what [case] are these things said? When he said to him, "Do [work] with me" in that manner, which is like "Weed with me today"; but [if] he said to him, "Do work with me" [meaning work] of [collecting] found items, etc.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 12b:8:1.hebrew: מאי בעיא גביה - דהיא נמי אינה יכולה למכור עצמה אחרי כן, כדאיתא בספרי:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 12b:8:1.english: Why is she with him? - For she too cannot sell herself afterwards, as stated in the Sifrei:
